name: Ithaca
text: A rocky island kingdom, good for goats, poor for horses. Home.

name: The Cyclops' cave
text: A great cave above the shore, pens of lambs and kids, cheeses drying on racks, and a stone door no mortal can move.

name: Delphi
text: The oracle on the mountainside, where a priestess speaks for the god.

name: Escape from the cave
text: Trapped in a giant's cave with the crew, the heroes must get past the stone door. Wine, a sharpened stake, and a false name are all they have.

name: The homecoming
text: Back on Ithaca in disguise, the hero must string the great bow and win back the hall.
